title: Page 10
content_zh:
“是刘伟强死了，不是我，不是赵廷汉死了。”
“你不就是刘伟强？”
苦笑，“简单说，刘伟强是我在问忠帮里面扮演的角色，我的真实身分还是赵廷汉。”
“我听不懂……”
摸摸她的脸颊，“小慧，我是警察，我在问忠帮里其实是卧底，负责调查刘兆的犯罪证据。”
刘兆人脉广，政商通吃，过去几次想办他都不成，就连马叔也因此遇害，遭到刘兆派人枪杀。
所以他进去，进到核心里收集证据，希望一次就能成功。
他除了让刘兆孤立，逐步清空问忠帮的那些大老外，最后更直取刘兆，让他就算后台再硬，因为证据确凿，也没人救得了他。
“警察？”她张着嘴，“你不是流氓吗？”
“我哪敢当流氓？我答应过你绝对不当流氓；既然你都瘦下来了，我也不能违背承诺啊！我当然不能当流氓。”
“可是你……”
“我在问忠帮里卧底，我算是卧底警察；那天我在你家，打电话联络那个男的过来，那个男的叫作马傲辰，他是个检察官，我就是与他合作。”
沈明慧听着他解释，这一切对她来说太离奇，太令人难以置信了。
原来她还在哀伤他的死亡，结果现在峰回路转，他没死，更离谱的是，他竟然还告诉她，他不是流氓，他是警察？！
“我在问忠帮卧底两年，唯一的目的就是收集足够的证据，让傲辰可以办刘兆，我现在的目的达到了，所以就结束任务，离开问忠帮。”
“可是电视上说，你……不是你！刘伟强中了很多枪啊！”
“那是我为了脱身，当时警方确实对我开枪，可是我有穿防弹背心啊！所以我没死……我真的很抱歉让你这么难过，但是我必须这样做，否则，我无法脱离问忠帮。”
他抱紧她，“刘伟强必须死，这是为了我自己，也是为了保护我身边的人，尤其是你。现在问忠帮等于瓦解了，如果刘伟强不死，大家知道刘伟强还活着，是由赵廷汉假扮的，你想我的日子会好过吗？”
她发抖，光是想到那个后果就害怕；但是他抱着她，很快就抚平她的担忧与恐惧，让她可以安稳的靠在他怀里。“这是真的吗？是不是你说来安慰我的？你……真的是警察？”
赵廷汉笑了，“就知道你会这样说……”从口袋里拿出警用证件

她看了一眼，笑了笑，靠在他身上。其实他说，她就信了，也不是怀疑，只是心情落差太大了。
从悲到喜，从绝望到希望，这种心情与情绪的落差真的太大了，她不想再品尝第二遍……
突然间，她又想起了什么，抬头看他，“那……那刘静之呢？你不是娶了她吗？”
“那是刘伟强娶了她，跟我没关系喔！”
“都是你，刘伟强也是你啦！”她把嘴巴捂上，不敢再说。
想起阿汉就是想要摆脱这一切，一开始才会用“刘伟强”这个假名，现在她绝对不能乱说，不然会给阿汉带来危险。
握住她的手，“别担心，这里不会有别人……那个刘静之其实是马傲辰拜托我娶的，因为马傲辰爱她，所以他拜托我娶她。”
“他爱他，可以拜托你娶她？”她听不懂。
“他拜托我娶刘静之保护她，你知道的，刘静之是刘兆的女儿，前阵子情势很复杂，问忠帮内……很乱，一言难尽，傲辰担心刘静之会受到伤害，所以才对我有此要求。”
沈明慧听着，很讶异会是这样的理由——没想到马傲辰身为检察官，竟然爱上了自己正在查办的黑帮老大的女儿。
赵廷汉抱着她，享受这份亲密，“你以为我脚踏两条船吗？其实我很痛苦，看着你伤心难过，我又不能跟你解释，我不想，更不能把你拖下水……我在你面前不是人，我在傲辰那边也不是人。”
他苦笑，“上回，刘静之跟我一起去听你的音乐会，听说就是因为他们两个在闹别扭，刘静之才会跟我一起去，只为了让傲辰嫉妒；结果倒霉的是我，我被傲辰揍了一顿。”
沈明慧想通，“难怪！难怪那天我拿票给你，要你带你老婆一起来听的时候，他会那么生气。”
“所以啰！我里外不是人。”他叹息，却笑了笑，而她也笑了笑，两人互望，心里前嫌尽释，此刻只剩下甜蜜、只剩下温馨。
他露出温暖的笑容，此刻，他终于可以恢复自己真实的本性，不需要再戴上面具过日子。“所以，拜托，别再说刘静之是我老婆，你多说几次，我真的会被傲辰揍死。”
他很夸张的说着，忽然他靠近她耳朵旁边，“而且我比较希望……你当我老婆。”
红了脸，低下头，靠在他怀里。
赵廷汉很满足，这两个月来的担忧与恐惧统统不再，心里那个洞也被填满了，不再感到空虚。
“对不起，最后还是没赶上你的音乐会。”
“没关系，以后还有机会啊！只要你好好的就好了。”

亲吻她的额头，“小慧，做我的妻子，好不好？”
她眼眶一湿，却是喜极而泣，点点头。
赵廷汉很高兴，紧紧抱着她。“说真的，我比较喜欢你以前的样子耶……抱起来比较舒服。”
“你不要得了便宜还卖乖好不好？”
“我哪有啊？我说的是真的嘛！”
“赵廷汉！”
“是！员警赵廷汉在此，请问长官有什么事？”
她哈哈笑着，他也微笑以对，用笑容将两人走过的路、经历的哀伤，统统掩盖。
唯一鲜明的，似乎只有年少时期对彼此的承诺，而他们，都没有违背承诺……
赵廷汉带着沈明慧下山，远离了山林，回到了台北。
明慧很感谢精舍里的师父收留她、照顾她，也开导她，至少没让她傻到真的去走上绝路；虽然在这里每天都要做很多事，可是至少她没有真的伤害自己，否则她真的会后悔。
回到台北，她要面对的麻烦比廷汉更多——她得面对经纪人与经纪公司，得面对亲朋好友的讶异与追问。
只有徐绍阳一脸意料中的事的样子，所有人当中，也只有绍阳哥知道廷汉与刘伟强的关系，沈明慧当然拜托他保密。
除此之外，每个人对于沈明慧在短时间内交到个警察当男朋友都很讶异，尤其是陈姊，不断的追问着她的状况。
陈姊甚至还害怕的说：“你是不是真的跟前阵子死掉的那个刘伟强在一起啊？”根据她的观察，以及刘伟强曾多次进出明慧独居的住所，她忧心的猜测。
而陈姊的忧心是理所当然，开玩笑，一个国际知名音乐家，竟然跟流氓谈恋爱，这传出去还得了？
“才没有呢！人家怎么可能跟流氓在一起……不过陈姊，改天我介绍我男朋友给你认识……他是个警察喔！”
“你什么时候交男朋友的？而且还是跟警察在一起？”不过陈姊心想，如果是警察，那就好多了。
沈明慧笑得很灿烂，但没有回答。同样的问题，在她带着廷汉回家去给父母看的时候，又重新被问了一遍。
脱去流氓气息，廷汉穿着西装，高大的身材、英俊的外貌，其实很称头，再加上警察的身分，沈父与沈母倒也没什么话好说。

虽然沈父一直希望撮合女儿跟绍阳那孩子，可是女儿既然心有所属，而且这男人是个警察，还算正当，那他们也就没什么话好说。
content_en:
"It was Liu Weiqiang who died, not me or Zhao Tinghan."
"Aren't you Liu Weiqiang?"
Smiling bitterly, "To put it simply, Liu Weiqiang is the character I play in the Wenzhong Gang, and my true identity is Zhao Tinghan."
"I don't understand..."
Touching her cheek, "Xiaohui, I'm a police officer. I'm actually an undercover agent in the Wenzhong Gang, responsible for investigating Liu Zhao's criminal evidence."
Liu Zhao had a wide network of contacts and was involved in both politics and business. He had been unable to deal with him several times in the past. Even Uncle Ma was killed because of this and was shot dead by Liu Zhao's men.
So he goes in, gets into the core and collects evidence, hoping to get it right the first time.
In addition to isolating Liu Zhao and gradually clearing out the big foreigners in the Wenzhong Gang, he finally targeted Liu Zhao directly and told him that no matter how tough his backing was, no one could save him because of the solid evidence.
"Police?" She opened her mouth, "Aren't you a gangster?"
"How dare I be a gangster? I promised you that I would never be a gangster; now that you have lost weight, I can't break my promise! Of course I can't be a gangster."
"But you..."
"I am working undercover in the Wenzhong Gang. I am considered an undercover police officer. I was at your house that day and called the man to come over. The man's name is Ma Aochen. He is a prosecutor. I am cooperating with him."
Shen Minghui listened to his explanation. All this was too bizarre and unbelievable to her.
It turned out that she was still mourning his death, but now it turns out that he is not dead. What's even more outrageous is that he actually told her that he was not a gangster, but a policeman? !
"I have been an undercover agent for the Wenzhong Gang for two years. My only purpose was to collect enough evidence so that Ao Chen could deal with Liu Zhao. Now that I have achieved my goal, I will end the mission and leave the Wenzhong Gang."
"But the TV said, you... it's not you! Liu Weiqiang was shot many times!"
"That was my attempt to escape. The police did shoot me at that time, but I was wearing a bulletproof vest! So I didn't die... I'm really sorry to make you so sad, but I have to do this, otherwise, I won't be able to escape from the Wenzhong Gang."
He hugged her tightly, "Liu Weiqiang must die, both for myself and to protect the people around me, especially you. Now the Wenzhong Gang has collapsed. If Liu Weiqiang does not die, everyone knows that Liu Weiqiang is still alive and was pretended by Zhao Tinghan. Do you think my life will be easy?"
She trembled, scared just thinking about the consequences; but he held her and quickly calmed her worries and fears, allowing her to lean safely in his arms. "Is this true? Did you come to comfort me? Are you...really a policeman?"
Zhao Tinghan smiled, "I knew you would say that..." He took out his police ID from his pocket.
She took one look, smiled, and leaned against him. In fact, he said that she believed him, and it was not that he was doubtful, but that the mood gap was too big.
From sadness to joy, from despair to hope, the gap in mood and emotion was really too big. She didn't want to experience it a second time...
Suddenly, she remembered something again and looked up at him, "Then... what about Liu Jingzhi? Didn't you marry her?"
"That's because Liu Weiqiang married her, it has nothing to do with me!"
"It's all you, Liu Weiqiang is also you!" She covered her mouth, not daring to say any more.
Thinking that Ahan just wanted to get rid of all this, she used the pseudonym "Liu Weiqiang" from the beginning. Now she must not say nonsense, otherwise it will bring danger to Ahan.
Holding her hand, "Don't worry, there won't be anyone else here... That Liu Jingzhi was actually asked by Ma Aochen to marry her. Because Ma Aochen loves her, he asked me to marry her."
"He loves him, can he please marry her?" She didn't understand.
"He asked me to marry Liu Jingzhi to protect her. You know, Liu Jingzhi is Liu Zhao's daughter. The situation was very complicated a while ago. The Wenzhong Gang was... very chaotic. It's hard to explain. Ao Chen was worried that Liu Jingzhi would be harmed, so he made this request to me."Shen Minghui listened and was surprised by the reason - she didn't expect that Ma Aochen, as a prosecutor, would fall in love with the daughter of the gang boss he was investigating.
Zhao Tinghan hugged her and enjoyed the intimacy, "Do you think I am in two different boats? In fact, I am in pain. Seeing you sad, I can't explain to you. I don't want to, let alone drag you into the water... I am not a human being in front of you, and I am not a human being in Ao Chen's side."
He smiled bitterly, "Last time, Liu Jingzhi went to your concert with me. I heard that it was because the two of them were having a quarrel that Liu Jingzhi went with me, just to make Ao Chen jealous. In the end, I was the unlucky one, and I was beaten up by Ao Chen."
Shen Minghui thought about it, "No wonder! No wonder he was so angry when I gave you the tickets that day and asked you to bring your wife to listen."
"So! I am not human inside and out." He sighed, but smiled, and she smiled too. The two looked at each other, and all the previous resentment in their hearts was gone. At this moment, only sweetness and warmth remained.
He smiled warmly. At this moment, he could finally return to his true nature and no longer needed to wear a mask to live his life. "So, please, stop saying Liu Jingzhi is my wife. If you say it a few more times, I will really be beaten to death by Ao Chen."
He said exaggeratedly, and suddenly he came close to her ear, "And I would rather... you become my wife."
Blushing, she lowered her head and leaned into his arms.
Zhao Tinghan was very satisfied. The worries and fears of the past two months were all gone. The hole in his heart was filled, and he no longer felt empty.
"Sorry, I didn't make it to your concert in the end."
"It doesn't matter, there will be opportunities in the future! As long as you are good, it will be fine."
Kissed her forehead, "Xiaohui, will you be my wife?"
Her eyes were wet, but she was crying with joy and nodded.
Zhao Tinghan was very happy and hugged her tightly. "To be honest, I prefer the way you looked before...it's more comfortable to hold you."
"You don't want to take advantage of it, but you still behave well, okay?"
"How could I? What I said is true!"
"Zhao Tinghan!"
"Yes! Police officer Zhao Tinghan is here. What can I do for you, sir?"
She laughed, and he smiled back, using his smile to cover up the path the two of them had traveled and the sadness they had experienced.
The only thing that seemed clear was the promise they made to each other when they were young, and neither of them broke their promise...
Zhao Tinghan took Shen Minghui down the mountain, away from the mountains and forests, and returned to Taipei.
Minghui was very grateful to the master in the monastery for taking her in, taking care of her, and enlightening her, at least not making her stupid enough to go to a dead end. Although she had to do a lot of things here every day, at least she didn't really hurt herself, otherwise she would really regret it.
When she returned to Taipei, she had to face more troubles than Tinghan - she had to face her agent and agency, and she had to face the surprise and questioning of her relatives and friends.
Only Xu Shaoyang looked like he had expected it. Among everyone, only Brother Shaoyang knew about the relationship between Ting Han and Liu Weiqiang. Of course, Shen Minghui asked him to keep it a secret.
In addition, everyone was surprised that Shen Minghui got a policeman as her boyfriend in a short period of time, especially Sister Chen, who kept asking about her situation.
Sister Chen even said in fear, "Are you really with the Liu Weiqiang who died a while ago?" Based on her observations and the fact that Liu Weiqiang had been in and out of the residence where Minghui lived alone many times, she made a worried guess.
Sister Chen's worry is natural. Just kidding, an internationally renowned musician is actually in a relationship with a gangster. How can this spread?
"No! How can I be with a gangster... But Sister Chen, I'll introduce you to my boyfriend another day... He's a policeman!"
"When did you have a boyfriend? And he was still with the police?" But Sister Chen thought to herself, it would be much better if it was a police officer.
Shen MingHui smiled brightly but did not answer. The same question was asked again when she took Tinghan home to show her parents.
After taking off his gangster aura, Tinghan wore a suit. He was tall and handsome, and he was actually very handsome. Plus, as a police officer, Father Shen and Mother Shen didn't have much to say.
Although Father Shen had always hoped to bring his daughter together with that kid from Shaoyang, since his daughter had a heart and the man was a policeman, so he was legitimate, they had nothing to say.
